row.notes: Penalty log vector (this+8..+0x10, stride 0x30): searches an equal record (bytes +8..+0xb car/type/reason, ints +0xc..+0x20, floats +0x24/+0x28, int +0x2c); appends it when absent (error-trace code 2 path). Callers: Sess_PenaltyLog_ReceiveAddRecord, Sess_PenaltyLog_RemoveVehicle, Sess_PenaltyLog_SendRecord, Sess_PenaltyLog_SendRecord_2. cv2-verify: finds an equal record and erases it; never appends

verify.notes: V3775 Loop compares record fields (+8..+0xb, ints +0xc..+0x20, +0x1c, floats +0x24/+0x28, +0x2c) with param_2 and on a match ERASES it (shifts followers down, shrinks end -0x30); when absent it only does an error-trace (code 2) and returns - it never appends. Better name Sess_PenaltyLog_RemoveMatchingRecord.
